pins.title: Plaster & Mohair Hideaway
pins.boardDesc: Shelter from the rain in a cavernous, heated reading alcove wrapped in tactile warmth.
pins.popupDesc: Designed for the ultimate introvert, this cavernous reading nook is tucked beneath a sweeping architectural staircase. Walls of seamless, bone-colored Tadelakt plaster meet a cool slate flagstone floor, while a plush rust-toned mohair armchair invites you to stay. A sleek, intelligent space heater emits a subtle, radiant warmth, piercing through the moody, diffused daylight of a rainy afternoon.
pins.imageAlt: Sleek Dyson Hot+Cool purifier standing on slate flagstone flooring beside a rust-colored mohair armchair, enclosed in curved bone-colored plaster walls during a moody, rainy afternoon.
